correctness.rationale: The explicit two-state corrector satisfies \(\mathcal Lh_i=\mu_i-g_i\) in both states and makes each corrected switching-work jump constant. Conditional stationary moments \(m_{i,1}=D_i/\kappa_i\) and \(m_{i,0}=D_i/\kappa_i+D_i/q\) are obtained by exact generator identities. Independent continuous Brownian drivers eliminate continuous cross-brackets; common Poisson switches yield a deterministic off-diagonal bracket \(q c_i c_j T\). Stationary martingale isometry gives exact finite-time corrected-work covariance \(T\Sigma\), and finite fourth moments plus the martingale CLT prove the physical-work covariance limit and vector Gaussian theorem. Symbolic/rational identity checks and independent exact-segment simulation passed; the latter is illustrative only.

value.rationale: The cross-work noise is strictly positive even without mechanical interparticle interactions. Its coefficient factors entirely through individual mean powers and the shared switching rate, yielding a parameter-free cross-work identification formula. The complete covariance separates an independently sourced diagonal thermal component from a common rank-one environmental component, and identical-particle collective work has an extensive-to-quadratic crossover. These are exact structural and inverse-statistical results not obtainable from one-time spatial correlations or a list of independent one-particle work variances.
